Iris (Design): quick drop: exploring a micro-toolbar for the latency card that keeps p95 prominent but adds a tiny control rail: timeframe icon, sampling badge, copy CSV. sketch: https://www.figma.com/file/microtoolbar/latency-exps

Iris (Design): main question: will a micro-toolbar feel discoverable if the sampling control is a reduced badge (\"1/10\") vs a full label (\"Sampling 1/10\")? goal = minimal noise for dashboards with many cards.

Dan (Eng): badge wins for density. fewer characters = less wrapping. impl note: badge should be a single interactive that opens a popover with slider + presets. avoids extra tab stops in the card header.

Noemi (PM): ops feedback: they want one-tap copy without hunting. If badge is the only visible element, make copy persistent on the right. maybe copy moves left when card is pinned.

Kai (A11y): accessibility checklist: ensure badge is focusable, has aria-label that reads the full state (e.g., \"Sampling: one in ten\"). popover must be reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space) and focus trapped while open. toast on copy should be aria-live polite.

Iris (Design): agree on focusable badge. Visual variants: (A) badge-only compact, (B) badge+micro-label, (C) badge hidden behind kebab. I'm leaning A with an affordance dot to indicate interactivity.

Dan (Eng): pick A but make the badge a11y-friendly. Implementation: <button aria-label=\"Sampling: 1 in 10\" aria-haspopup=\"true\">1/10</button> open popover. For copy: use existing util:
```
navigator.clipboard.writeText(csv)
```
and emit console toast via ops-bot.

Noemi (PM): microcopy: use \"Adaptive sampling\" in tooltips and aria labels instead of \"Auto\". Add tooltip on copy: \"Copy visible timeframe as CSV (up to 10k rows)\".

Kai (A11y): tooltip wording good. Also request: legend must not rely on color alone. add pattern overlays in legend and provide a sr-only list like: \"Legend: Low, Medium, High\" for screen readers.

Iris (Design): will add pattern samples to legend artboard and sr-only labels in spec. Also plan to include focus states (2px outline, 3:1 contrast against bg) and hover tooltips that include the sampling rate when open.

Dan (Eng): one practical point: full-grid pattern for every heatmap cell will be heavy. proposal: use pattern in legend + highlight stripes on hover cells. pattern in legend communicates mapping without rendering heavy assets.

Kai (A11y): acceptable. also make sure p95 tooltip includes aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen label value (e.g., \"p95: 245 ms\"). screen readers should get the numeric + context.

Noemi (PM): telemetry requests: `micro_toolbar_copy` (with sampling_rate), `sampling_preset_changed` (preset value, compact vs expanded). keep payloads low cardinality.

Dan (Eng): will add events and a 5s client-side throttle for copy to avoid accidental spam during incidents. also gate the micro-toolbar behind a feature flag for 2-week canary.

Iris (Design): lifecycle: I'll update figma with badge states, popover content, tooltip strings, and the legend pattern. I'll add an a11y checklist in the spec doc. linking preview: https://img.redwood.com/micro-toolbar/preview.png

ops-bot: uploaded 2 assets to staging/latency/micro-toolbar/ (build 2026-03-27T08:30Z)

Kai (A11y): happy to review the copy and keyboard flow. ping me when ready and we can do a quick pass.

Iris (Design): will do. thanks all. :raised_hands:

Noemi (PM): one last tiny ask 1: show a small tooltip hint the first time a user sees the micro-toolbar: \"Tip: press Enter on the sampling badge to change sampling\". track impression event `micro_toolbar_hint_shown`.

Dan (Eng): ok one-time hint can be localStorage gated. will emit `micro_toolbar_hint_shown` once and not again.

Iris (Design): perfect. end.
